The only point common to all intervals is 0, since the upper endpoints tend to zero; the intersection is {0}. If ℕ includes zero, the index still starts at n=1, so the answer does not change.
en.c) Fₙ=(-1/n,1/n). Интервалы вложены: Fₙ₊: c) Fₙ=(-1/n,1/n). The intervals are nested: Fₙ₊₁⊂Fₙ. The union is the largest, F₁=(-1,1). The intersection is {0}: zero belongs to all of them, and any x≠0 is excluded for sufficiently large n.
en.d) Fₙ=(-1/n,n). Эти интервалы возрастают: d) Fₙ=(-1/n,n). These intervals grow: the left endpoint tends to 0 from the left (but is always negative), the right endpoint goes to +∞. en.B△C: B\\C=(-10,−4)∪{8}, C\\B=∅, значит B: B△C: B\C=(-10,−4)∪{8}, C\B=∅, so B△C=(-10,−4)∪{8}. B△D=∅, since D⊆B. C△D: [−4,8], since C and D are disjoint and the point 8 is added to C.
en.Если формулировка «для множеств A и B из: If the wording “for sets A and B from problem 3” means only the A and B defined there, the answer is A△B=(-∞,−10]∪(−3,8]. The other pairs are given as a useful extra.
en.Обозначим множества работников по языкам: Denote the sets of workers by language: F (French), E (English), R (Russian). Given |F|=17, |E|=42, |R|=85; |E∩R|=12, |F∩R|=13, |F∩E|=8; |F∩E∩R|=5. The pairwise numbers are understood to include those who know all three languages.
en.Только французский. Из всех 17 французог: French only. From all 17 French speakers we subtract those who also know English and those who also know Russian; people with all three were subtracted twice, so we add them back once: 17−8−13+5=1.
en.Французский, но не русский. Сначала |F\\: French but not Russian. First |F\R|=|F|−|F∩R|=17−13=4. Check by category: F only =1; F and E but not R = |F∩E|−5=3; the sum 1+3=4.
en.Схема включений-исключений для трёх множ: The inclusion–exclusion scheme for three sets: |F∪E∪R|=|F|+|E|+|R|−|F∩E|−|F∩R|−|E∩R|+|F∩E∩R|. The total number of workers here is 17+42+85−8−13−12+5=116, if every worker knows at least one of these languages.
en.P(A) («степень» или булеан множества A): P(A) (the “power set” of A) — the set of all its subsets, including ∅ and A itself. If A has exactly n elements, then |P(A)|=2ⁿ.
en.b) A=∅. Единственное подмножество пустог: b) A=∅. The only subset of the empty set is ∅ itself, so P(∅)={∅}; it is important not to confuse this with ∅.
en.c) A={∅} — одноэлементное множество, эле: c) A={∅} — a one-element set whose element is the empty set. Its subsets: ∅ and {∅}; so P(A)={∅,{∅}}.
en.d) A={{{a}},{a},a}. Это три различных эл: d) A={{{a}},{a},a}. These are three distinct elements: {{a}}, {a}, a. So there are eight subsets: ∅; {{{a}}}; {{a}}; {a}; {{{a}},{a}}; {{{a}},a}; {{a},a}; {{{a}},{a},a}. When reading, watch the levels of curly braces: nesting changes the element.
